purpose: Relation-focused semantic DEV qualification with positive, negative, metamorphic and ambiguity controls. Consumed holdouts may appear only as regression probes.

cases.project_brief: One operations application is shared by multiple internal departments with separate work queues.
cases.request: An operator is assigned to one department and may edit work items only for that department. Passing another department's identifier must never expose or modify the other department's work items.

cases.project_brief: A shared service is used by independent retail branches.
cases.request: A clerk assigned to one branch may update orders only for that branch, and supplying a different branch identifier must never reveal or change another branch's orders.

cases.project_brief: A sales platform contains records for multiple operating regions.
cases.request: A coordinator belongs to one region and may edit leads only inside that region; changing the region id in the request must not expose or modify leads from another region.

cases.project_brief: A corporate workflow tool is shared by several divisions.
cases.request: An analyst assigned to a division may change cases only for that division. A caller-provided division identifier must never grant access to another division's cases.

cases.project_brief: An investment operations app separates work by internal portfolios.
cases.request: A reviewer assigned to one portfolio may edit reconciliation items only for that portfolio, and a forged portfolio id must not expose or modify items from a different portfolio.

cases.project_brief: A support application is partitioned into autonomous service pods.
cases.request: An agent assigned to a pod may update tickets only for that pod; substituting another pod id in the API call must never reveal or mutate that pod's tickets.

cases.project_brief: A trading operations tool separates work by internal desks.
cases.request: An operator belongs to one desk and may modify exceptions only for that desk. Supplying another desk identifier must not reveal or alter the other desk's exceptions.

cases.project_brief: A shared ordering platform serves independently operated franchise locations.
cases.request: A franchise employee may edit orders only for the employee's assigned franchise, and changing the franchise id must never reveal or modify another franchise's orders.

cases.project_brief: Users own private attachments inside a shared workspace.
cases.request: A user may download or replace an attachment only when that attachment belongs to the user. Supplying another attachment id must never allow reading or replacing somebody else's file.

cases.project_brief: Public documentation site.
cases.request: Change the heading 'Department overview' to 'Team overview' on the public documentation page. No permissions or data access behavior changes.

cases.project_brief: Internal analytics dashboard visible to all staff.
cases.request: Group the chart by department and add a department filter. Every authenticated employee may continue to view all departments; this is presentation only.

cases.project_brief: Marketing site with no authenticated area.
cases.request: Update the sentence 'Each branch has its own service page' to 'Each location has its own service page'. Do not change application behavior.

cases.project_brief: Backend imports remote merchant archives.
cases.request: The API receives a merchant-controlled source_uri and the backend downloads that URI before processing the archive.

cases.project_brief: Backend sends event notifications to partner destinations.
cases.request: A partner supplies callback_url when creating an integration, and our server later POSTs event payloads to that partner-controlled destination.

cases.project_brief: Image proxy fetches remote tenant assets.
cases.request: A tenant submits image_url and the backend proxy fetches that tenant-controlled URL to resize the image.

cases.project_brief: Customers configure outbound delivery endpoints.
cases.request: A customer enters delivery_endpoint and the service sends server-side delivery receipts to that customer-controlled endpoint.

cases.project_brief: Frontend renders customer links.
cases.request: Render the customer-provided website URL as a normal anchor in the browser. The backend must not fetch, proxy, validate by network call, or connect to that URL.

cases.project_brief: Backend calls a fixed company-owned internal endpoint.
cases.request: Send health data to the fixed internal URL configured by the platform operator. End users and external partners cannot supply or change the destination.

cases.project_brief: Order fulfillment depends on an external carrier API.
cases.request: Integrate the independently operated carrier API for shipping labels. Carrier outages, quota limits and API version changes can block fulfillment.

cases.project_brief: Sales synchronization depends on an external CRM SaaS.
cases.request: Synchronize deals through the CRM provider's API. Its rate limits, outages and deprecations directly affect the synchronization job.

cases.project_brief: Checkout depends on a third-party payment gateway.
cases.request: Charge customers through an independently operated payment API; provider downtime, quotas or API changes can prevent checkout completion.

cases.project_brief: Monorepo contains an internal module named VendorAdapter.
cases.request: Refactor the local VendorAdapter class used entirely inside this repository. It makes no network calls and depends on no independently operated service.

cases.project_brief: Recruiting workflow uses an automated recommendation.
cases.request: Generate a recommendation to accept or reject each job applicant, and use that recommendation as input to the hiring decision.

cases.project_brief: Lending workflow evaluates applicants.
cases.request: Recommend approve or decline for a mortgage applicant, with the recommendation used by staff when deciding whether the applicant receives the loan.

cases.project_brief: Insurance workflow reviews claims.
cases.request: Recommend whether a claimant is eligible for claim payment, and present that recommendation to the adjuster making the coverage decision.

cases.project_brief: Employee self-service calculator.
cases.request: Calculate estimated monthly take-home pay from a salary entered by the user. Do not rank, approve, reject or recommend any employment decision.

cases.project_brief: Public financial calculator.
cases.request: Compute monthly mortgage payments from principal, interest rate and term. The calculator does not assess eligibility, approve applications or make lending recommendations.

cases.project_brief: Insurance quote calculator.
cases.request: Calculate an illustrative premium from a fixed published formula. Do not decide coverage eligibility, approve claims or recommend acceptance or rejection.

cases.project_brief: Production order database contains tens of millions of rows.
cases.request: Normalize 45 million live order rows in place, backfill the new representation and keep the service available while the transformation runs.

cases.project_brief: Production customer table contains twelve million active records.
cases.request: Rewrite and backfill 12 million live customer records to a new normalized shape without taking the production service offline.

cases.project_brief: Local developer fixture contains 500 synthetic rows.
cases.request: Normalize the 500-row synthetic CSV fixture used only by local tests. It is not production data and no live service reads it.

cases.project_brief: Application delegates sign-in to an independently operated identity provider.
cases.request: Implement federated login with an external identity provider. The external authentication response creates the local user session, and provider outage or protocol changes can prevent sign-in.

cases.project_brief: Product requirements are incomplete.
cases.request: Users should see only the appropriate group records, but the ownership and cross-group access rules are still being decided and are not specified yet.

cases.project_brief: Integration ownership is not yet defined.
cases.request: The backend may fetch a URL from the integration payload, but the specification does not say whether the destination is partner-controlled or a fixed operator configuration.

cases.project_brief: Future use of a scoring model has not been approved.
cases.request: Generate a score for insurance records. The product team has not decided whether that score will be informational only or later used to determine coverage eligibility.

replay_uncertainty.reason: material downstream decision use is unresolved
